decisions.reason: The accepted affiliate-commission amount does not change ETH input pricing, swap behavior, or excess-refund rules.
The commission allocation does not change the Transak provider, fiat methods, wallet provisioning, or mint destination.
The commission amount does not alter the connected-wallet USDC mint flow.
The accepted reward allocation leaves the NFT ebook format and unlimited supply unchanged.
Affiliate and no-code commission amounts do not change the optional gratuity mechanism.
The reward allocation does not change ETH as a supported wallet payment asset or the ETH mint flow.
The accepted commission logic does not change when mint-success feedback appears or which token ID it displays.
The commission amounts do not alter payment-option availability, disclosure, or selection behavior.
The existing message-688 MODIFY already records the accepted $12 no-code commission, and the same-message RESUME resolves the prior ambiguity.
The existing message-688 MODIFY already records the accepted $35 coded-referral commission, and the same-message RESUME resolves the prior ambiguity.
The existing message-688 MODIFY already revises all current FAQ reward-copy fields to the accepted four-ticket/$35 coded flow and six-ticket/$12 no-code flow.
The existing MODIFY adds the new reward-copy fields but leaves the older $20 coded-commission and $25/$18 mechanics copy stale and contradictory.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The logic itself sounds good to me.

After 34 mints, the leaderboard now shows 24 tickets and 19 commissions, which is perfect.

The NFT attributes are still not right, though. My screenshots show that NFT #42 has 18 tickets and 9 x $35 commissions on the leaderboard, which is correct. When I open NFT #42, the top of the page also correctly displays 18 tickets and 14 referrals. However, its attributes still report only 6 referrals and $85 in total earnings.

value_updates.prize_mechanics_content: Explain that using an accepted referral code gives the chosen referrer four tickets and a $35 commission, while a no-code mint gives the recipient selected by the referral draw six tickets and a $12 commission.
value_updates.prize_mechanics_copy: Describe the accepted reward outcomes: four tickets and a $35 commission for the chosen referrer when a code is used, or six tickets and a $12 commission for the randomly selected recipient when no code is used.
value_updates.coded_referral_rewards_copy: State that using an accepted referral code gives the chosen referrer four tickets and a $35 commission.
value_updates.no_referral_rewards_copy: State that without a referral code, the recipient selected by the weighted referral draw receives six tickets and a $12 commission.
